_schema.preset: id, group, name, description, width, height, radius, font (default family), fonts (Google Fonts family specs to load), sides.front / sides.back
_schema.derived: extends (base id) + any of: sides (whole-side replacement), background (per side), overrides (per side, per layer id: changed fields only), layers (per side, appended). Everything else is inherited.
_schema.background: {type:'color', color} | {type:'gradient', angle, stops:[{pos:0..1, color}]} | {type:'image', src, fit:'cover'|'contain'|'stretch', color}
_schema.layer.text: id, label, text, x, y, after (id of a layer this one is placed right of; gap px),  size, weight, color, font, align(left|center|right), baseline(alphabetic|middle|top), letterSpacing, italic, lineHeight, maxWidth, rotate, opacity, strokeColor, strokeWidth, uppercase, visible, editable
_schema.layer.rect: id, label, x, y, w, h, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, radius, rotate, opacity, visible
_schema.layer.image: id, label, x, y, w, h, src, fit, radius, rotate, opacity, visible
_schema.variables: texts may contain {{date}}, {{date+1y:DD.MM.YY}} (offsets d/m/y, format DD MM YYYY YY) and {{random:4}} (digits, stable per card seed)
_schema.coordinates: pixels in the preset's own width x height space; text x/y is the anchor point according to align/baseline
